name: Food planner
description: Plan meals and manage a shopping list

answer.title: Food planner
answer.description: Menus recipes and an editable shopping list
answer.fallback: Open the food planner to browse meals, inspect recipes, edit servings and manage a saved shopping list. AI suggestions require an explicit button and review before Apply.
answer.html:
Food planner

Loading saved plan…

Menu setup
Diet and targets (optional)

For mixed menus, the first selected number of days are vegetarian.

Calorie targets guide planning. Source calories can be missing and may include serving suggestions; substitutions can change them.

Recipe sources

AI selects sourced recipes; it does not write recipe instructions.

Refine recipe search

Labels and calories come from the source. Unknown values stay visible by default. Targets are guides, not strict rules.

Suggested change

Menu

Shopping list

Add an item

Lidl products

Connect the prepared catalogue folder in template settings.

Plan or change meals

Optional AI ingredient check

Normally only shortlisted titles, recipe IDs and diet labels go to the AI. This sends names from the chosen recipe, without quantities or cooking instructions.
